const iotdata_field_clouds_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %" PRIu8 " okta\n", label, _padd(label), v->clouds);

iotdata_field_solar_t *const v = vv; return unpack_solar_irradiance(buf, bb, bp, &v->solar_irradiance) && unpack_solar_ultraviolet(buf, bb, bp, &v->solar_ultraviolet);
const iotdata_field_solar_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %" PRIu16 " W/m2, UV %" PRIu8 "\n", label, _padd(label), v->solar_irradiance.solar_irradiance, v->solar_ultraviolet.solar_ultraviolet);

iotdata_field_rain_t *const v = vv; return unpack_rain_rate(buf, bb, bp, &v->rain_rate) && unpack_rain_size(buf, bb, bp, &v->rain_size);

const iotdata_field_rain_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s %" PRIu8 " mm/hr, %" PRIu8 ".%" PRIu8 " mm/d\n", label, _padd(label), v->rain_rate.rain_rate, v->rain_size.rain_size10 / 10, v->rain_size.rain_size10 % 10);
